name: RENOIR
protocol_note: Distinguish RAW and processed releases; lower-noise references retain residual noise.

name: SIDD
protocol_note: RAW and sRGB are separate tracks; preserve the official scene and device splits.

name: DND
protocol_note: Use the official regions and evaluation protocol; hidden references are not a clean training pool.

name: DPDD
protocol_note: Specify single-image or dual-pixel input; defocus results are distinct from motion deblurring.

name: RealBlur
protocol_note: Keep RealBlur-J and RealBlur-R separate and follow the stated alignment and intensity protocol.

name: I-HAZE
protocol_note: Haze is physically generated and photographed; this is not digital synthesis or natural fog sampling.

name: O-HAZE
protocol_note: Record the benchmark release and split; references are separately captured clear scenes.

name: NH-HAZE
protocol_note: Spatially nonuniform haze tests a different capture regime from uniform controlled haze.

name: LOL
protocol_note: Identify LOL-v1 or the exact later release; normal-light exposure is a selected target.

name: LSRW
protocol_note: Some outdoor pairs have local offsets; report registration and device subsets.

name: SICE
protocol_note: Keep source exposure sequences disjoint; references involve selected enhancement or fusion outputs.

name: SPA-Data
protocol_note: Clean targets use temporal information and semi-automatic construction; avoid source-video leakage.

name: RealRain-1k
protocol_note: Keep density subsets and reference construction explicit; SynRain-13k is a separate synthetic dataset.

name: GT-RAIN
protocol_note: Rainy and clear captures are temporally separated; identify the release and alignment protocol.

name: RealSnow
protocol_note: Background references derive from static-scene videos; keep source sequences disjoint.

name: GoPro
protocol_note: Sharp real frames are integrated to create blur; this is not a captured long exposure.

name: HIDE
protocol_note: Specify subset and use of human-region annotations; preserve the video split.

name: RESIDE SOTS
protocol_note: Separate indoor and outdoor subsets; synthetic fidelity does not establish natural-fog generalization.

name: Rain100L and Rain100H
protocol_note: Keep the light and heavy variants and their release-specific image lists separate.

name: CSD
protocol_note: Synthetic flakes and veiling effects are distinct from naturally captured snowfall.

name: Snow100K synthetic subsets
protocol_note: Identify S/M/L particle-size subsets; do not mix these with the separate realistic collection.

name: RESIDE URHI
protocol_note: No aligned clear references; a separate clean training pool must be documented.

name: RESIDE RTTS
protocol_note: Object annotations support downstream tests; they are not aligned clean images.

name: Snow100K realistic snowy collection
protocol_note: The realistic snowy photographs are separate from the paired synthetic test subsets.

name: EnlightenGAN low and normal-light pools
protocol_note: Use the authors' dataset instructions; distinguish independent training pools from paired evaluation benchmarks.

name: ACDC
protocol_note: Adverse and normal-condition scenes are not pixel-aligned restoration ground truth.
